scope: Retrospective comparison using the six original training cases and their version-1 cached features. No official Test data was read. No artifacts or candidate settings were changed. All six cases were already available during feature and candidate development; this is not external or blind validation.
selection_metric: Mean linear rank-decay over inner held-out cases
tie_policy: max returns first candidate in the frozen ordered list; original relative candidate order preserved
grouping: Whole-case holdouts; exact source SHA256 duplicate groups excluded together at both levels
